affixes.name: Aegis
affixes.description: Increase Defense. Upon reaching a certain level, increase Physical Resistance.

affixes.name: Tenacious
affixes.description: Increases Maximum Health. Upon reaching a certain level, increases Healing.

affixes.name: Bulwark
affixes.description: Increase Block Damage Reduction Rate. Upon reaching the required level, reduce Block Energy Cost.

affixes.name: Spirit Spring
affixes.description: Increases Springhorn Healing. Upon reaching a certain level, increase Springhorn Charge. This effect must be activated outside of combat.

affixes.name: Iron Helmet
affixes.description:
Increase Critical Damage Resistance. Upon reaching the required level, reduce the impact of Critical Hits received.
Critical Hit: Hitting weak points deals Critical Hits, increasing DMG based on Critical DMG while enhancing Impact. The head is a weak point for both Gyldhunters and most monsters.

affixes.name: Physical Damage Reduction
affixes.description: Increases Physical Resistance.

affixes.name: Magical Damage Reduction
affixes.description: Increases Magic Resistance.

affixes.name: Ethereal
affixes.description: Increase Fall Damage Resistance. Upon reaching the required level, falling no longer causes stagger.

affixes.name: Stoic
affixes.description: When Health is below {Tough_1_HealthThreshold_#2}%, increase Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance. Upon reaching a certain level, when Health is below {Tough_2_HealthThreshold_#2}%, restore Health. Cooldown: {Tough_2_Cooldown}s.

affixes.name: Brotherhood
affixes.description: While alive, grants increased Defense to yourself and allies. If multiple team members have this affix, only the highest-level affix takes effect. Upon reaching a certain level, grants increased Attack to yourself and allies.

affixes.name: Spirit Shield
affixes.description: Increases shield strength. Upon reaching a certain level, the shields you apply grant Magic Resistance to shielded units while active.

affixes.name: Unyielding
affixes.description: Each time you take damage from a different enemy, you gain Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance for {Tenacious_1_Duration}s. Entering combat refreshes this duration. Stacks up to 2 times. Upon reaching a certain level, the maximum stacks increase to 4.

affixes.name: Distant Ward
affixes.description: If the distance between you and the attacker is greater than {RemoteEnhance_1_Distance_#4} meters when hit, temporarily increases your Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance. Upon reaching a certain level, you also resist minor impacts from distances greater than {RemoteEnhance_1_Distance_#4} meters; once triggered, this effect has a cooldown of {RangedDefense_2_Cooldown}s.

affixes.name: Resilience
affixes.description:
Reduces the duration of debuffs received. Upon reaching a certain level, suffering a crowd control debuff temporarily increases your Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance.
Crowd Control Debuffs: Crowd control debuffs include Stunned, Frozen, Immobilize, and Dodge Distance Reduction.

affixes.name: Valor
affixes.description: Increases Attack. Upon reaching a certain level, also increases Defense Penetration.

affixes.name: Powerful
affixes.description: Increase Physical Damage.

affixes.name: Wise
affixes.description: Increase Magic Damage.

affixes.name: Headshot Damage
affixes.description: Increases Critical Damage.

affixes.name: Defence Penetration
affixes.description: Increases Defense Penetration.

affixes.name: Wrath
affixes.description: When Health is below {BloodThirsty_1_HealthThreshold_#2}%, increase Physical Damage and Magic Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, when Health is below {BloodThirsty_2_HealthThreshold_#2}%, increase Attack.

affixes.name: Skypiercing
affixes.description: Casting skills in the-air increases Physical Damage and Magic Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, aerial casting also reduces Skill Energy Cost.

affixes.name: Fervid
affixes.description: When Health is above {NoDamage_1_HealthThreshold_#2}%, increase Physical Damage and Magic Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, when Health is above {NoDamage_1_HealthThreshold_#2}%, reduce Skill Energy Cost.

affixes.name: Seeker
affixes.description: Hitting an enemy increases Movement Speed for {HitSwiftness_1_Duration}s. Upon reaching a certain level, the Speed Boost can stack.

affixes.name: Lifebane
affixes.description: Hitting an enemy with more than {HealthBane_1_HealthThreshold_#2}% Health temporarily increases Physical Damage and Magic Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, hitting an enemy with more than {HealthBane_2_HealthThreshold_#2}% Health temporarily increases Attack.

affixes.name: Ranged
affixes.description:
If the distance between you and the target is greater than {RemoteEnhance_1_Distance_#4} meters when hit, temporarily increase Physical Damage and Magic Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, increase ranged damage's effective range.
Effective Range: Different ranged attacks have different Effective Ranges. Beyond the Effective Range, both DMG and Impact will diminish.

affixes.name: Fervor
affixes.description: After hitting an enemy, increase Physical Damage and Magic Damage for {SwiftAttack_1_Duration}s, stacking up to 5 times. Upon reaching the required level, when the number of stacks is greater than or equal to 3, increase Defense Penetration.

affixes.name: Smiting
affixes.description:
On a Critical Hit, recover Energy. Cooldown: {WeaknessBreak_1_Cooldown}s. Upon reaching a certain level, on a Critical Hit, reduce the cooldown of all skills. Cooldown: {WeaknessBreak_2_Cooldown}s.
Critical Hit: Hitting weak points deals Critical Hits, increasing DMG based on Critical DMG while enhancing Impact. The head is a weak point for both Gyldhunters and most monsters.

affixes.name: Burst
affixes.description: Increases the damage of Withered Knight's Wither Execution.

affixes.name: Strife
affixes.description: Increases Melee Weapon Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, increases Melee Weapon Damage for each nearby enemy, up to 3 stacks.

affixes.name: Eloquence
affixes.description: Increases Chanting Speed. Upon reaching a certain level, chanting cannot be interrupted by minor Impact. Cooldown: {FastCast_2_Cooldown}s.

affixes.name: Seamless
affixes.description: Increases Skill Cooldown Speed. Upon reaching a certain level, knocking down a Gyldhunter reduces skill cooldowns currently in progress.

affixes.name: Vitality
affixes.description: Increases Maximum Energy. Upon reaching a certain level, when entering a state of Energy Overdraft, you become immune to that specific instance of Energy Overdraft. Cooldown: {Vitality_2_Cooldown}s.

affixes.name: Swift
affixes.description: Increases Movement Speed while Crouching, Silent-Walking, Aiming and Chanting.

affixes.name: Elusive
affixes.description: Reduces Dodge Energy Cost.

affixes.name: Reduced Skill Stamina Cost
affixes.description: Reduces Skill Energy Cost.

affixes.name: Reduced Block Stamina Cost
affixes.description: Reduces Block Energy Cost.

affixes.name: Increased Stamina Recovery Speed
affixes.description: Increases Energy Recovery Speed.

affixes.name: Deft
affixes.description: Increases Interaction Speed. Interactions cannot be interrupted by minor Impacts; once triggered, this effect has a cooldown of {InteractionSpeed_2_Cooldown}s.

affixes.name: Siphon
affixes.description: Killing an enemy recovers Health. Upon reaching a certain level, it also increases Attack for {KillHeal_2_Duration}s.

affixes.name: Blessing
affixes.description: Increase the duration of Buffs granted by you.

affixes.name: Curse
affixes.description: Increase the duration of Debuffs inflicted by you.

affixes.name: Wealth
affixes.description: Increase the amount of Gyldenblod from PvE in dungeons.

affixes.name: Focused
affixes.description: Increases Charging Speed. Upon reaching a certain level, increases Movement Speed while charging.

affixes.name: Creation
affixes.description:
Increases the duration of Constructs. Upon reaching a certain level, successfully summoning a Construct increases Physical Damage and Magic Damage for a period of time.
Constructs: Objects generated by players that have a limited lifespan and can be destroyed are collectively referred to as Constructs, such as: the Seer's Rune Pillar, Frostbite Trap, Eye of True Sight, mushroom traps from Spore Arrow, Forbidden Gate, etc.
